  Read in: 简体中文 · 正體中文 · Tiếng Việt · 日本語 · Italiano · Nederlands · Deutsch · Українська

  
  
  
  
  
  

  

  

## Start here

| You have | Go to |
|---|---|
| **An Android TV or Google TV** | [Quick start](#quick-start): a coding assistant does the work in about fifteen minutes. |
| **A Samsung, LG, Roku, Vizio or Hisense VIDAA TV** | [cleanyour.tv/not-android](https://cleanyour.tv/not-android): CleanYourTV can't run there, but you can turn off the tracking with your remote. |
| **Only an Android phone** | The community-built [Clean Your TV app](https://cleanyour.tv/app): no laptop, no coding agent. |
| **Want to see it first** | [What you get](#what-you-get): screenshots of the new home screen. |

**Official links:** [cleanyour.tv](https://cleanyour.tv) and this repo. Other domains using the name, such as
cleanyourtv.com, are not run by this project ([#1004](https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv/issues/1004)).

[How it works](#how-it-works) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [What you get](#what-you-get) ·
[Supported TVs](#supported-tvs) · [Doing it by hand](#doing-it-by-hand) · [The launcher](#the-launcher) ·
[Restoring](#restoring-your-tv) · [Firmware updates](#after-a-firmware-update) ·
[Questions](#questions-people-ask) · [Contributing](#contributing)

## How it works

Android TVs have the same debug bridge as Android phones. Switch on USB debugging in the TV's
developer options, allow your computer once, and the rest is standard Android tooling:

| Step | What happens |
|---|---|
| **Back up** | The list of installed packages and settings. |
| **Disable** | The manufacturer's telemetry, ad services, content rows and preloaded junk, with `pm disable-user`. Nothing is uninstalled, so a restore script can undo every step. |
| **Install** | A small native launcher, made the default home screen. |

**No root, no cable, nothing uninstalled, and a one-line restore if you change your mind.**

The bloat differs by brand, so the prompt has your coding assistant discover it on your TV and ask
before touching anything you might use.

## Quick start

| You have | Do this |
|---|---|
| **A computer** | Use the prompt with a coding assistant: the three steps below. |
| **A computer, no coding assistant** | Run the three steps yourself: the commands are in [Doing it by hand](#doing-it-by-hand). |
| **Only an Android phone** | Use the community-built [Clean Your TV app](https://cleanyour.tv/app) by [@udhaykumarbala](https://github.com/udhaykumarbala): connect, analyse, clean, in about five minutes. No laptop, no coding agent. |

The three steps below are written for a coding assistant: the computer needs to be on the same Wi-Fi as
the TV, with a shell on it, plus Python 3, a JDK from 17 through 22, and Android SDK platform 34
with build-tools 34 (the assistant builds the launcher there).
Without an assistant, [Doing it by hand](#doing-it-by-hand)
is the same job, run by you, and it has the install commands.

Any of these work: Claude Code (on [0G Private Computer](https://pc.0g.ai/?utm_source=cleanyourtv&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=readme) or an [Anthropic plan](https://claude.com/pricing)), [Codex](https://github.com/openai/codex), [Gemini CLI](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli) or [Antigravity CLI](https://antigravity.google/product/antigravity-cli).

| Where | What to do |
|---|---|
| **1. On the TV** | Settings → Device Preferences → About → press OK on **Build** seven times → back → Developer options → **USB debugging** on. If you see a Network or ADB debugging toggle, turn that on too. Keep the TV on. |
| **2. On your computer** | Clone the repo and open that folder in your assistant (`git clone https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv`), then paste [`PROMPT.md`](PROMPT.md) and fill in your TV model. |
| **3. Follow along** | Accept "Allow USB debugging?" on the TV, then answer the checklist: which apps you use, the dock size and app order, whether to keep the voice assistant, Chromecast and updates. |

Cloning matters: the assistant reuses this repo's `tools/disable.sh` and `launcher/build-and-install.sh`
instead of writing its own, and that is where the backup, the Home guard and the restore record live.

The assistant backs up, debloats, builds and installs the launcher, and checks each step with
screenshots pulled from the TV. With this repo as context it takes about fifteen minutes.

## What you get

A home screen that looks like an Apple TV and gets out of the way:

| Part | What it looks like |
|---|---|
| **A pitch-black home** | A dock of your four favourite apps in a rounded band, where Apple TV puts it. |
| **A top shelf** | Names the focused app in large type, with an ambient glow in a colour taken from its artwork. |
| **The rest of your apps in a grid** | Slides up when you press Down. |
| **One floating glass highlight** | Springs from tile to tile. The focused tile lifts and shows its name. |
| **Three frosted buttons** | Inputs (HDMI ports under the names you gave them in the TV's settings, AV, Live TV), Wi-Fi or Ethernet with the network name, Settings. |
| **A greeting, a thin clock and the date** | In [Outfit](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Outfit), and a matching Clock screensaver. Set `show_stats` in config or a theme for one line under the clock: CPU, free memory and free storage. It stays off unless you turn it on, and it refreshes only while Home is on screen. |
| **Themes and module cards** | Themes change colours, wallpaper, dock and columns without a rebuild, and module cards let other apps plug a tile in, only with your say-so. |

And a TV that stops working against you: no sponsored rows, no "Discover" nags, no analytics
phoning home, no apps you never asked for.

oss.description: 中文版 AI 姿势参考图库 · 1439 组 / 2878 张图片 / 完整汉化 · 零依赖静态画廊
oss.readme:
# AI Pose Gallery · 中文版

> 288 组 / 1439 张 AI 人体姿势参考图，日文数据完整汉化，附可直接部署的响应式静态画廊。

![画廊预览](docs/preview.jpg)

手机端预览

![手机端预览](docs/mobile.jpg)

**在线演示：** 
**原始站点：** 
**原作者：** ギア（@giaaibusi）
**中文版维护：** Anhao · [X @anhao_ai](https://x.com/anhao_ai)
**GitHub：** 

---

## 这是什么

原站是一套面向 AI 绘画 / 3D / 摄影参考的姿势图库，元数据全部为日文，且不提供批量素材下载。本仓库做了三件事：

1. **全量镜像** —— 1439 条记录对应的 1439 张缩略图（JPG 300×400）与 1439 张原图（PNG 900×1200）全部落地，共 2878 个文件 / 659.5 MB。
2. **完整汉化** —— 日文字段逐条译为中文，覆盖 4 个体系、26 个分类、288 个姿势名、5 个视角，零遗漏。
3. **可用的前端** —— 零依赖响应式画廊，完整实现原站的分类筛选、多角度切换、分组浏览、灯箱导航与原图下载，并针对手机重新设计布局。

## 页面功能

- 4 个体系页签，显示各体系的图片数与姿势组数
- 姿势名、编号、ID、分类关键词搜索，支持 `/` 快速聚焦
- 动作分类、5 种视角组合筛选，可一键重置
- **按姿势分组 / 逐张浏览**双模式，分组卡片带多角度缩略图
- 悬停或点击缩略图切换主图角度，点击卡片打开灯箱
- 灯箱先显示缩略图、再加载 900×1200 原图，支持直接下载 PNG、复制 ID、新窗口打开
- `← / →` 切换角度，`↑ / ↓` 切换姿势，`Esc` 关闭；手机支持左右滑动
- PC 多列网格、手机双列网格，移动端筛选面板可展开/收起
- 使用指南与注意事项弹窗，页脚标注图片来源与维护者链接

## SEO 与分享

页面内置了完整的 SEO 与社交分享配置：

- 关键词化标题：`AI 姿势参考库｜288 组人体姿势 · 1439 张多角度参考图`
- 独立 description、keywords、author 与 `max-image-preview:large`
- `canonical` 指向正式域名，避免自定义域名与 pages.dev 域名重复收录
- Open Graph / Twitter Card 使用 1200×630 的 `og-cover.jpg`
- JSON-LD 结构化数据：`WebSite` + `ImageGallery`，声明语言、简介与页面主图
- `robots.txt` 放行全站并声明 sitemap，`sitemap.xml` 指向首页
- 语义结构：单一 H1、分区 H2、卡片 H3；缩略图 `alt` 含姿势名与视角，图片懒加载

仓库中的绝对地址统一指向 `https://ai-pose-gallery.anhao.app/`。Fork 后如使用其他域名，需同步替换 `index.html` 的 canonical、`og:*`、`twitter:*`、JSON-LD，以及 `robots.txt`、`sitemap.xml` 中的地址。

## 数据规模

| 体系 | 条数 |
| --- | ---: |
| 全身单人・标准系 | 365 |
| 全身单人・性感系 | 399 |
| 上半身单人 | 400 |
| 双人缠绵 | 275 |
| **合计** | **1439** |

每条记录对应 5 个视角中的若干个：正面 / 斜侧 / 侧面 / 俯视 / 仰视。

## 目录结构

```
.
├── index.html              # 单页画廊（零依赖，直接打开即可）
├── robots.txt              # 搜索引擎抓取规则
├── sitemap.xml             # 站点地图
├── og-cover.jpg            # 1200×630 社交分享封面
├── data/
│   ├── pose.json           # 原始日文数据（1439 条，未改动）
│   ├── pose-zh.json        # 中文数据（前端实际读取，含检索字段）
│   ├── meta.json           # 原始体系分类
│   ├── meta-zh.json        # 中文体系分类
│   └── translations.csv    # 日⇄中对照表（323 条，便于校对）
├── thumbs/                 # 缩略图 1439 张 JPG 300×400（22 MB）
├── img/                    # 原图 1439 张 PNG 900×1200（637 MB）
├── scripts/
│   ├── download.py         # 并发下载器（48 线程 / 断点续传 / 自动重试）
│   ├── i18n.py             # 日译中词典（唯一值去重后的 323 条译文）
│   ├── apply_translation.py# 回填译文，生成中文数据
│   ├── verify.py           # 校验文件完整性（存在性 / 大小 / 图片头）
│   └── build.sh            # 生成 Cloudflare Pages 发布目录 dist/
├── docs/                   # README 页面预览图
├── _headers                # Cloudflare Pages 缓存策略
├── LICENSE
└── README.md
```

## 数据结构

`data/pose-zh.json` 字段说明：

| 字段 | 原日文字段 | 示例 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | — | `full_sexy_P001_front` | 唯一标识 |
| `体系` | `系統` | 全身单人・性感系 | 4 大类 |
| `姿势编号` | `ポーズ番号` | `P001` | 80 组编号 |
| `分类` | `分類` | 站姿 | 26 类动作 |
| `姿势名称` | `ポーズ名` | S形站姿・胯部侧顶 | 288 种描述 |
| `角度` | `アングル` | 正面 | 5 种视角 |
| `缩略图` | `サムネ` | `thumbs/…jpg` | 相对路径 |
| `原图` | `原寸` | `img/…png` | 相对路径 |
| `检索` | — | 拼接串 | 供前端模糊搜索 |

原始日文数据 `data/pose.json` 保持原样，字段名与站点接口一致，便于对照或回灌。

## 本地预览

画廊通过 `fetch` 读取 JSON，需要 HTTP 环境（直接双击 `index.html` 会被 CORS 拦截）：

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8000
# 打开 http://127.0.0.1:8000
```

页面支持体系/分类/视角组合筛选、关键词搜索、分组与逐张浏览、多角度缩略图、懒加载、灯箱原图下载、键盘与触屏导航。

## 脚本用法

```bash
# 重新拉取全部图片（已存在的文件自动跳过，可反复执行）
python3 scripts/download.py
WORKERS=64 python3 scripts/download.py   # 调整并发

# 修改 scripts/i18n.py 中的译文后，重新生成中文数据
python3 scripts/apply_translation.py

# 校验 2878 个文件是否完整
python3 scripts/verify.py
```

## 部署到 Cloudflare Pages

仓库为纯静态站点，无框架、无依赖。

**方式一：GitHub 自动部署（推荐）**

1. 登录 Cloudflare Dashboard → **Workers & Pages** → **Create** → **Pages** → **Connect to Git**
2. 选择本仓库 → 生产分支 `main`
3. 构建设置照抄：

   | 字段 | 值 |
   | --- | --- |
   | Framework preset | `None` |
   | Build command | `bash scripts/build.sh` |
   | Build output directory | `dist` |

4. **Save and Deploy**，约 2–5 分钟得到 `https://.pages.dev`
5. 之后每次 `git push` 自动重新发布

> ⚠️ **不要**把 Build output directory 直接填 `/`。仓库根目录含 `.git`（数百 MB），
> Cloudflare 会把它当静态资源扫描，pack 文件超过 25 MiB 单文件限制会导致构建失败。
> `scripts/build.sh` 只拷贝 `index.html`、`_headers`、`data/`、`thumbs/`、`img/` 到 `dist/`。
> 若确实想用根目录，仓库已附 `.assetsignore` 兜底排除非站点文件。

> 站点限制：单文件 ≤ 25 MiB、每次部署 ≤ 20,000 个文件。本仓库最大文件 917 KB、共 2883 个文件，均在限制内。

**方式二：命令行直传**

```bash
bash scripts/build.sh
npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name ai-pose-gallery-zh
```

`_headers` 已为 `img/`、`thumbs/` 配置一年期强缓存，图片不会重复回源。

## Agent 技能（Skills）

`skills/` 下提供 5 个 `SKILL.md` 格式的 Agent 技能，让 AI Agent 按姿势名 + 视角检索本仓库的白模图，作为生图 / 生视频的姿势参考：

| 技能 | 图片数 | 范围 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `pose-reference-standard` | 365 | 全身单人・标准系 |
| `pose-reference-upper` | 400 | 上半身单人 |
| `pose-reference-sexy` | 399 | 全身单人・性感系（18+） |
| `pose-reference-couple` | 275 | 双人缠绵（18+） |
| `pose-reference-all` | 1439 | 全部 |

每个技能含 `SKILL.md`（用法 + 姿势目录）与 `references/catalog.csv`；csv 的 `图片` 列是**相对技能根目录**的路径（`../../img/.png`），直接复用本仓库 `img/`，不重复存图、不依赖外链。

### 安装：手动

技能通过相对路径读取仓库的 `img/`，所以要**保留整个仓库**，再把技能目录**软链**（不要复制）到 Agent 的技能目录。以 Claude Code 为例（个人技能目录 `~/.claude/skills/`，项目级为 `/.claude/skills/`）：

```bash
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/anhao/ai-pose-gallery-zh.git ~/ai-pose-gallery-zh
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
ln -s ~/ai-pose-gallery-zh/skills/pose-reference-standard ~/.claude/skills/pose-reference-standard
# 需要全部技能：for d in ~/ai-pose-gallery-zh/skills/pose-reference-*; do ln -s "$d" ~/.claude/skills/; done
```

重启 Claude Code 或新开会话后输入 `/skills`，能看到 `pose-reference-*` 即可。仓库移动位置后需重新建软链。

只想要可单独拷贝、自带图片（WebP）的版本，可用独立技能包仓库 [jasoncai0/pose-reference-skills](https://github.com/jasoncai0/pose-reference-skills)。

### 安装：让 Agent 帮你装

把下面这段话发给 Claude Code（或其他能执行命令的 Agent），按需改技能名：

```text
请帮我安装姿势参考技能：把 https://github.com/anhao/ai-pose-gallery-zh 浅克隆到 ~/ai-pose-gallery-zh
（需要完整仓库，技能会用相对路径读取仓库里的 img/），然后把 skills/pose-reference-standard
软链到 ~/.claude/skills/pose-reference-standard（不要复制）。完成后检查
references/catalog.csv 里每一行的「图片」路径相对技能目录都能找到文件，告诉我总行数和缺失数。
```

要装全部技能，把「skills/pose-reference-standard」改成「skills/ 下全部 pose-reference-* 目录」。

# ub-mode

`ub-mode` is an agent skill that enforces disciplined software engineering principles when writing or changing code. It is loosely based on portions of [@poteto](https://github.com/poteto)'s rules (`poteto-mode` / `pstack`), reduced and paired with deterministic quality-gate tools:

1. **First Make it Work** — Laziness Protocol, Foundational Thinking, TDD, Redesign From First Principles, Attack the Premise, Subtract Before You Add, Outcome-Oriented Execution, Build the Lever, and Architecture (Model the Domain, Boundary Discipline, Type System Discipline, Make Operations Idempotent, Separate Before Serializing Shared State).
2. **Then Make it Right** — Fix Root Causes, Sequence Work into Verifiable Units, Test Behavior (Not Implementation), [Crapper](https://github.com/unclebob/crapper) (`CRAP = 0.8` similarity) are eliminated.
- [unclebob/mutator](https://github.com/unclebob/mutator) — Runs mutation testing to expose uncovered code and surviving mutants that tests fail to catch.
- [unclebob/uml-viewer](https://github.com/unclebob/uml-viewer) — Visualizes components, coverage, CRAP, mutation scores, and dependency directions.

## Installation

Copy `SKILL.md` into your agent's skills directory as `ub-mode/SKILL.md` (for example `~/.grok/skills/ub-mode/SKILL.md`, `~/.claude/skills/ub-mode/SKILL.md`, or `~/.cursor/skills/ub-mode/SKILL.md`), then invoke `/ub-mode`.

# Horizon

Horizon is Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 rewritten in Rust: a native game that reads the same worlds, follows the same rules and generates the same terrain as the Java game, and is checked against it by more than 300 differential harnesses. You play it through a small launcher, on the files from your own copy of Minecraft. It is free, open source and unofficial.

> Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft. Horizon contains no Minecraft code, assets or data: you need your own legally obtained copy of Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3.

## Download

Horizon is installed through **the Horizon launcher**. Get it from [playhorizon.dev](https://playhorizon.dev) (the Download button picks your system) or from [the launcher releases](https://github.com/horizon-rust/horizon/releases?q=launcher-v&expanded=true), for Linux x86-64, macOS on Apple Silicon or Windows x64. The launcher installs the game and keeps it up to date with each new build (Horizon ships on one channel, the Nightly), prepares its files from your copy of Minecraft (your own install, or downloaded from Mojang for your account), and updates itself.

**You need** a Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition (the launcher signs in with it, as other launchers do; see [Microsoft account](docs/microsoft-account.md)) and a GPU with Vulkan or OpenGL 3.3 on Linux, Vulkan or DirectX 12 on Windows, or any Apple Silicon Mac. Nothing else: with no Minecraft on your computer, Play downloads 26.3 and the Java it needs from Mojang for your account, as the official launcher does, then prepares it once. An install you already have (the official launcher, Prism, MultiMC and other launchers all work) is used instead. Step by step, with macOS's first-open prompt and the first launch: [Install and first launch](https://playhorizon.dev/docs/install).

  
    
    
  

## What works today

The [documentation](https://playhorizon.dev/docs/) covers each of these.

- **The game:** singleplayer with vanilla's world generation, mobs, villagers, raids, redstone, every command, the HUD and the recipe book, on saves in vanilla's format. Worlds from 1.8 to 26.2 are upgraded as vanilla does. [Status table](#project-status).
- **Horizon's own extras:** new menus (vanilla's are one setting away), graphics presets, distant terrain up to 1024 chunks, controller support, optional zoom, minimap and more, all off by default where they would change the vanilla look. See [Settings](https://playhorizon.dev/docs/settings).
- **Resource packs and data packs:** resource packs work, and data packs load functions, predicates, item modifiers and world generation, taller levels included (vanilla's biomes for now).
- **Playing with others:** invite friends from the pause menu's Friends button with a code, Open to LAN, and joining servers, online-mode ones with the Microsoft account the launcher signs in with. See [Multiplayer](https://playhorizon.dev/docs/multiplayer).
- **Mods:** content mods add blocks, items and data, and native mods change the game's own Rust code, built by the launcher on your copy, with no Rust to install. Horizon's own (Zoom, FPS Counter, Keystrokes, Minimap, Recipes and Coordinates HUD) are native mods. Java mod jars do not run in Horizon. See [Mods and data packs](https://playhorizon.dev/docs/mods).

## Host a server

The launcher's **Servers** page creates, starts, backs up and updates a Horizon server with buttons, and invites friends over Tailscale. On a VPS, `horizon-server` installs with one command and runs without Java. Guide: [Host a server](https://playhorizon.dev/docs/hosting) ([reference](docs/hosting.md)).

## Modpacks

The launcher's **Modpacks** page imports a Modrinth or CurseForge pack, shows which of its mods Horizon can carry over, and plays the ones it can as their own profile. Today that means content mods made of data and assets; mods with Java code are not ported yet. See [Modpacks](https://playhorizon.dev/docs/modpacks).

## Agent control

AI agents and scripts can play Horizon. `horizon-ctl`, shipped beside the game in every release folder, is a command line that reads the game as JSON and acts like a player; `horizon-ctl mcp` serves the same commands as an MCP server (one tool per command, screenshots returned as images).

```sh
horizon-ctl launch --world Survival --seed 5 --wait   # finds the version the launcher installed
horizon-ctl state                                       # position, health, food, target, screen...
horizon-ctl find-block birch_log                        # the nearest logs
horizon-ctl goto -0.5 65 -2.5 --near 2.5                # walks there along a path
horizon-ctl break -1 65 -3                              # mines it; replies with the drops
horizon-ctl open-inventory && horizon-ctl click-slot 0  # menus: slots, buttons by label, text fields
```

Commands block until the action is done and reply with what happened; errors are JSON with distinct exit codes, `horizon-ctl help` lists every command and `horizon-ctl COMMAND --help` explains one with examples. It talks to the game over a Unix socket on Linux and macOS and over a token-protected localhost port on Windows. See [Agent control in the native client guide](docs/native-client.md#agent-control-horizon-ctl-and-mcp).

  When a project without a detected framework has a `functions` directory, autoconfig asks whether it is a Cloudflare Pages project. Non-interactive runs (CI and coding agents) assume it is not and continue as a static site. When the static files are in the project root, that deploys the root as static assets, and the Pages Functions (the project's API routes) are not deployed.

  In that case autoconfig now stops with an error explaining that Pages Functions cannot be migrated automatically yet. For Pages Functions it suggests moving the static files into a subdirectory and deploying with `wrangler pages deploy`, or migrating the Functions to a Worker; for a `functions` directory that is not Pages Functions, it suggests moving the static files into a subdirectory or adding a configuration file. Projects whose static files are already in a subdirectory, projects detected as Pages or with a detected framework, and interactive runs where the user answers the prompt are unaffected.
